annotations.title: Get my stream overlay addresses for OBS

description: Get the three overlay addresses to add to OBS or any streaming software as a browser source: a goal bar, a wall of recent supporters, and an alert that appears when someone gives. Includes the size each source should be and when alerts currently fire.

alertSeconds.description: How long each alert stays on screen.

language.description: Which language the overlays speak. "page" follows the page language and keeps following it if that changes later.

wallRows.description: How many supporters the wall shows at once.

name: get_stream_overlays

addToObs.description: The steps to add one of these in OBS.

alertsFireOn.description: When the alert overlay reacts. "approved" is after the creator has looked at a support; "claimed" is as soon as a supporter marks a payment as sent, which is faster but unreviewed.

title: Get my stream overlay addresses for OBS
